import pathlib
base=pathlib.Path('/home/USER/continual-arc-baselines/.workbench/stage1/HPL0-prime-agent-luna6-low-ws0/frozen/held-out/play/users/u088/system/state/workspace/programs'); base.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    out = [row[:] for row in grid]
    fixed = {(r,c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 8}
    seen=set(); objects=[]
    for r in range(h):
        for c in range(w):
            color=grid[r][c]
            if color in (0,8) or (r,c) in seen: continue
            cells={(r,c)}; stack=[(r,c)]; seen.add((r,c))
            while stack:
                y,x=stack.pop()
                for q in ((y-1,x),(y+1,x),(y,x-1),(y,x+1)):
                    yy,xx=q
                    if 0<=yy<h and 0<=xx<w and q not in seen and grid[yy][xx]==color:
                        seen.add(q); cells.add(q); stack.append(q)
            objects.append((min(x for y,x in cells), cells, color))
    objects.sort(key=lambda z:z[0])
    occupied=set(fixed)
    for _,cells,color in objects:
        shift=0
        while all((r,c+shift+1) not in occupied and c+shift+1<w for r,c in cells):
            shift+=1
        moved={(r,c+shift) for r,c in cells}
        for r,c in cells: out[r][c]=0
        for r,c in moved: out[r][c]=color
        occupied |= moved
    return out
'''
